title: Research rustls's governance before drafting any proposal
design:
A research bead, and it comes first. Unknown right now: who maintains rustls, and whether there is any written process for blessing a third-party certificate verifier.

Drafting a proposal before knowing this risks addressing it to the wrong people in the wrong form, which spends the one chance to make a first impression. It also risks proposing something the project has already settled -- a declined prior proposal would change the whole approach, and is exactly the kind of thing that is cheap to find and expensive to miss.

Find: current maintainers and how decisions are actually made; any written policy on third-party verifiers or pluggable verification; prior art -- anyone who has proposed this before, and what happened; whether the CryptoProvider work has been discussed upstream already.

Blocks the integration epic's proposal work, not the contribution bead: a useful PR stands on its own regardless of governance.
acceptance_criteria:
[ ] Maintainers and decision process recorded
[ ] Any written policy on third-party verifiers found, or its absence confirmed
[ ] Prior proposals found and their outcomes recorded
[ ] A recommendation on form and venue before anything is drafted
